title: Control of postharvest soft rot of tomato fruit by kojic acid and the potential mechanisms involved in the inhibition on Pectobacterterium carotovorum subsp. carotovorum.
authors: Xin, Yu; Zhang, Xiaoyun; Godana, Esa Abiso; Dhanasekarana, Solairaj; Xie, Yuanyuan; Li, Jun; Zhao, Lina; Zhang, Hongyin
one_liner_zh: 研究曲酸对番茄采后软腐病的防治效果及其对病原菌的抑菌机制，其中仅涉及小分子与DNA的分子对接预测，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Soft rot is the major bacterial disease affecting postharvest tomatoes. After the tomato fruit is infected by the pathogen, Pectobacterterium carotovorum subsp. carotovorum (Pcc), the disease rapidly develops and leads to fruit deterioration. Kojic acid is a natural metabolite of several fungi during the fermentation process of traditional oriental food. In this study, we investigated the efficacy of kojic acid (fermentation product of Aspergillus oryzae) against tomato soft rot and explored the underlying mechanisms. Kojic acid at the concentration of 4 mg/mL exhibited significant efficacy in controlling tomato fruit soft rot by directly suppressing the pathogen's growth, both in vitro and in vivo, and the application of kojic acid has no adverse effects on the quality of tomatoes. The 1/2 minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC), MIC, and 4 mg/mL of kojic acid increased the permeability of the Pcc cell membrane, resulting in the leakage of intracellular substances. In other words, the integrity of the Pcc cell membrane was compromised upon kojic acid treatment. Kojic acid at different concentrations stimulated ROS accumulation and membrane lipid peroxidation of Pcc. In addition, kojic acid was predicted to bind with DNA through three hydrogen bonds based on molecular docking, and the binding of kojic acid to DNA was similar to that of ethidium bromide (EB). This disturbs the normal role of DNA. The control effect of kojic acid against postharvest soft rot of tomato fruit was explored for the first time, and the mechanisms involved in the inhibition of kojic acid on Pcc was revealed.
abstract_zh: 软腐病是影响采后番茄的主要细菌性病害。番茄果实被病原菌——胡萝卜软腐果胶杆菌胡萝卜亚种（Pectobacterterium carotovorum subsp. carotovorum, Pcc）感染后，病害迅速发生并导致果实腐烂。曲酸是几种真菌在传统东方食品发酵过程中产生的天然代谢产物。本研究探讨了曲酸（米曲霉发酵产物）对番茄软腐病的防治效果，并探究了其潜在机制。浓度为4 mg/mL的曲酸在体外和体内均通过直接抑制病原菌生长，显著控制了番茄果实软腐病，且曲酸处理对番茄品质无不良影响。1/2最小抑菌浓度（MIC）、MIC及4 mg/mL的曲酸增加了Pcc细胞膜的通透性，导致胞内物质泄漏。换言之，曲酸处理破坏了Pcc细胞膜的完整性。不同浓度的曲酸刺激了Pcc中ROS积累和膜脂过氧化。此外，基于分子对接预测，曲酸通过三个氢键与DNA结合，且曲酸与DNA的结合方式类似于溴化乙锭（EB）。这干扰了DNA的正常功能。本研究首次探讨了曲酸对采后番茄果实软腐病的防治效果，并揭示了曲酸抑制Pcc的相关机制。
